description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter named CategoryPreviewAdapter used to display a list of Product items in a category preview within an Android application. It includes a ViewHolder implementation, diff utility callbacks for efficient list updating, and binding logic for individual item views.

classes.name: CategoryPreviewAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a list of Product items with diff utility support.

classes.name: CategoryPreviewAdapter.ProductViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that binds Product data to the item view layout.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two Product items are the same based on their ID.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the contents of two Product items are the same.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Product item's data to the view components.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ProductViewHolder for a RecyclerView.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Product item to the ViewHolder and initiates item appearance animation.
